title: 宇树科技CFO：机器人价格已合理，未来智能按token计费
speaker: Jesse Liu

segments.en: Is that the vision? That is the vision, yeah. Okay, it's almost like getting the big computer into... Exactly. The desk of every person at the vision was with a computer. Exactly. What about robot prices? Because I know they've gone down significantly. I think some 90% or more in the last five or six years or so. Do you think robot prices can... I remember last time you came on, you said, it's not a matter of whether we can, but whether we should lower your prices. What do you think prices go from here? Yeah, we still shouldn't lower our prices. I think we've gotten to a good point where the current price point sort of supports the product value that it offers today.
segments.zh: 这是愿景吗？是的。就像把大型计算机放到每个人的桌上。机器人价格呢？过去五六年下降了90%以上。上次你说，不是能不能降价，而是该不该降价。现在价格会怎么走？我们仍然不应该降价。我认为当前价格点已经很好地支撑了产品价值。

segments.en: And for our sort of configuration, it's a general purpose humanoid. The big advantage is when the brain system develops, the hardware doesn't have to change that much. Maybe a new pair of hands, maybe some new vision sensors. And that's it. It's sort of a minor update to your car. You can think of it that way.
segments.zh: 对于我们的通用人形机器人配置，一大优势是当大脑系统发展时，硬件不需要大改。可能换新手、新视觉传感器，仅此而已。就像汽车的小升级。

segments.en: And then all the updates are actually done over the air, right? So you have this mega intelligence carrier of the future. A lot of the business models are going to be surrounding kind of how do we monetize intelligence itself? Currently, there's limited intelligence, especially limited intelligence in the open world. So we have to monetize that through the hardware. OK. In the future, the intelligence itself is going to carry most of the values. So it's going to be moving towards more of a token-based business model if we look forward that far.
segments.zh: 所有更新都是通过空中升级完成的。未来这是一个超级智能载体。很多商业模式将围绕如何将智能变现。目前开放世界的智能有限，所以通过硬件变现。未来智能本身将承载大部分价值，将转向基于token的商业模式。
